Desk lamp, concealed cables and a clean useful work surface.

Matte-black rear surround speakers and four flush ceiling grilles represent coordinated sound. Door pair is west wall near TV-wall end per plan: clear single-lite ivory frames. Recessed slim figurine shelves immediately right of doors viewed from inside; only show if in camera. No tinted glass, no added doors. No rows of glaring picture lights.

Charcoal low-sheen rubber floor, washable warm ivory walls, simple diffused linear ceiling light. All doors light ivory. Correct mirror reflection to actual opposite room; no invented windows or hallway.
